visualCharacteristics.purpose: Full-width rotating hero banner of linked, image-only slides with dot navigation
visualCharacteristics.description: Full-width image-only hero slider: 5 linked slides with text baked into the images, dot indicators overlaid at the bottom centre, autoplay.

contentPattern.structure: one row per slide; cell 1 = slide image linked to its target (link may wrap the image or sit next to it), cell 2 = optional overlay text (usually empty, text is baked into the image)

cells: Image (mandatory), linked to the slide target (link wrapping the image or a link in the row)
Text content (optional; usually empty because text is in the image)

usage: Home page hero banner rotating promotional images.
reuseGuidance: Use for image-only rotating banners where each slide is one linked image. For slides with authored overlay text use carousel.
